checks.finding: The archive and external manifest match the selected digests; the embedded manifest is byte-identical; its content-derived release ID is 9d3540ef8f33eb19.

All 454 declared payload files are present exactly once, have the declared size and digest, and match current source bytes; there are no extra payload members, unsafe paths, duplicates, links, or non-regular entries.

Private runtime identities and values are excluded. No complete PEM private key or literal secret assignment was found. The only private-key marker is parser source in the pinned jose dependency, not key material.

Stable and candidate profiles are closed tuples; mixed profile, unknown profile, hostile issuer/origin/ports/project/client values, and candidate migration from legacy stable configuration are rejected.
Operator paths and origins are allowlisted before TLS file reads or network access, and candidate setup/fresh-smoke pass the selected profile's configured operator origin.

The candidate uses separate release/current/state paths, systemd unit, Docker Compose project, volume namespace, and loopback ports 23443/28443/29443; the stable service is required active before install and after removal.

Server correlation IDs are fresh UUIDv4 values and caller correlation fields are rejected. The offered and queue partition equations include rejected, exported, dropped, and pending states; unit controls prove pending and completed conservation and reject double completion.

Before mutation, install_candidate.sh checks archive SHA-256, member safety, manifest presence/schema, and equality of the embedded manifest release_id with the caller-supplied release_id. A wrong release ID exits nonzero with both candidate roots absent.

All deterministic host preconditions, including auth-stage UID/GID and absence of both candidate roots, precede mutation. An install_committed flag and EXIT trap cover every later failure; before the final commit they stop/disable the candidate unit, down Compose when configured, remove current/unit/exact candidate roots, and reload systemd. release-id and current are published before install_committed becomes 1.
